title: The Museum
hook: 一家人去博物馆，看了女王的东西和真的恐龙骨头，每个人喜欢的房间都不一样。

cells.a: They are going to the museum to see things that are old.
cells.cn: 他们去博物馆看古老的东西。

cells.q: What is in the other room?
cells.a: There is another room with a real dinosaur in it.
cells.cn: 另一个房间里有一只真的恐龙。

cells.q: Whose things are in this room?
cells.a: They are all the things the queen had long ago.
cells.cn: 这些都是女王很久以前用过的东西。

cells.a: They showed her the queen's dress and golden crown.
cells.cn: 他们给她看女王的裙子和金王冠。

cells.a: She is imagining that she is a queen with a servant.
cells.cn: 她在想象自己是个有仆人的女王。

cells.q: What did Peppa ask in the museum?
cells.a: She asked what room it is and what people do there.
cells.cn: 她问这是哪个房间、人们在里面做什么。

cells.a: They found the dinosaur room with real dinosaur bones.
cells.cn: 他们找到了摆着真恐龙骨头的恐龙厅。

cells.a: The dinosaur room is George's favourite room in the museum.
cells.cn: 恐龙厅是乔治最喜欢的房间。

cells.q: What is Daddy Pig's favourite room?
cells.a: The museum cafe, because he likes cake and tea.
cells.cn: 博物馆的咖啡厅，因为他喜欢蛋糕和茶。

helper.order: First / Next / Then / After that / Finally
helper.keywords: museum, queen, crown, dinosaur, bones, cafe
helper.actions: go, look, imagine, find, ask, eat

opener: Today I watched Peppa Pig. This episode is “The Museum”.
ending: In the end, Daddy Pig likes the museum cafe best. My favourite part is ______.
